responsibility: Declares the Rust frontend’s canonical Rust keyword spellings and keyword lookup interfaces. It extends the token-defined keyword list with additional multi-token or synthesized spellings, defines the Keywords class containing static token-map and set declarations plus per-keyword string constants, and lists weak keywords separately, so lexer and parser code can consistently classify reserved and contextual identifiers.
same_name_distinction: Interface/definition header for the rust-keyword-values pair: it extends the token macro list with synthesized spellings such as $crate, {{root}}, and 'static, and declares the Keywords and WeakKeywords constants, while rust-keyword-values.cc instantiates the actual map and set objects from those declarations.
